source.title: One recorded person, the real Presage SDK, the real verifier
source.dataset: rPPG Dataset by Ashfak Yeafi on Kaggle (ashfakyeafi/rppg-dataset), subject 1
source.license_note: The dataset lists no licence, so no frame or image of the person is shown or kept. Only the numbers the SDK produced are bundled.
source.video: First 330 s of the recording, centre-cropped to 4:3 and scaled to 640x480 at 30 fps, the same shape the browser camera sends
source.sdk: @smartspectra/node-sdk 3.4.0, file input, run on this server
